The issuer displays a solid capital structure with total assets of $4,156M against total liabilities of $2,441M (equity of $1,715M) and strong short-term liquidity indicated by a current ratio above 2.5x. However, profitability metrics are relatively thin, with an operating margin (EBIT/Revenue) of roughly 6.4% and net income of $19M, pointing to moderate debt-service coverage and operational leverage. These credit fundamentals align with an investment-grade rating in the BBB category, reflecting adequate capacity to meet financial commitments alongside moderate credit risk.

DECISION: BBB
